cohort: Neonates admitted to the NICU of Mustafa Khomeini Hospital in Tehran, Iran, between 2007 and 2014, who were suspected of sepsis and met sepsis criteria.
finding: The most common sepsis pathogens were Staphylococcus aureus and E. coli, with varying resistance rates to antibiotics such as ceftriaxone (5%), cefotaxim (30%), gentamycin (15%), and imipenem (16.7%).
